Based on the image provided, here is the description of the expanded category button (the "Breakfast" button that has been clicked):

**(1) Text Orientation:**
The full category name **"Breakfast"** is visible on **ONE HORIZONTAL LINE**. The text does not wrap or break vertically; it sits on a single line next to the icon.

**(2) Appearance of the Expanded Button:**
*   **Size:** The button is significantly larger and taller than the unselected category buttons below it. It spans almost the entire width of the menu column.
*   **Color & Shape:** It is a large, rounded rectangle with a solid, light cream or pale yellow background color. It features a subtle drop shadow or border that makes it pop out from the background.
*   **Content:** Inside the button, there is a colorful square icon (depicting a sunrise/sunset) on the left, followed by the bold text "Breakfast", and a small circular badge with the number "6" on the far right.

**(3) 'Tap Again' Hint:**
**Yes**, there is a hint visible. A small, white tooltip or speech bubble appears pointing towards the expanded button (specifically near the top right edge of the "Breakfast" card). The text inside reads **"Tap again to sel..."** (it appears truncated, likely "select"). This text is oriented horizontally within the bubble.
